title: Midsommar
tagline: Eat at the long table. Wear the flowers.
about: A grieving young woman travels to a remote Swedish commune for a midsummer festival that turns sinister.
cue: Serve the feast when Dani is crowned May Queen and the table toasts her.
faces: after dark, for dinner and a film at
